items.q: He started playing fife in an aggregation of Miss Smith's... a lady named Smith. She got a bunch of kids together in a fife-and-drum corps, and he started playing fife in that band

ctx.x: We'll now take you back to Boston again and continue where we left off, and discuss Howard Johnson, who was perhaps the most...

Well, Howard was a very serious musician. He started playing fife in an aggregation of Miss Smith's... a lady named Smith. She got a bunch of kids together in a fife-and-drum corps, and he started playing fife in that band, and flute also. He was a very good pianist, piano player.
